notes: First 50 test images in manifest order; no selection by quality. 60,000 train / 5,000 validation / 5,000 test, with 2,048 separate calibration images. Exact epoch-50 weights; fixed head trained for 10 additional epochs. RCPS calibration, target 90% average coverage; measured coverage need not equal 90%. RCPS uses delta=0.05 and assumes independent calibration images; not a per-image coverage guarantee. Ensemble: five Gaussian-NLL members; MC dropout: 30 fresh reproducible draws, seed 20261002 + method index. Both maps share their pooled 99.5th-percentile scale. Example predictions and calibrated bounds clipped to [0,1] before calculating metrics and maps. Historical full-test aggregate metrics remain unclipped. Float32 arrays; full-precision metrics. Error is averaged after taking channelwise absolute differences. Width is upper minus lower, averaged over RGB. MC per-example metrics can differ from the original evaluation because these are fresh draws.
